title: VTG Carriage by Timex Indiglo Quartz Women’s Watch Blue Strap Japan Movt AS IS
descriptionText:
VTG Carriage by Timex Indiglo quartz women’s watch featuring white dial, blue hands, and blue textured strap.
Watch shows cosmetic wear on the case including finish loss and scratches from normal use. Strap appears to be a replacement and shows light wear. Working condition unknown and battery not tested, therefore being sold AS IS for repair, parts, or restoration.
Please review photos carefully for condition details
